subject: spanish
topicDisplay: Area C: The World Around Us
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'The plane is delayed'?
questions.explain: 'Llevar retraso' means 'to be delayed', so 'El avión lleva retraso' = 'The plane is delayed'.

questions.q: Which means 'I will travel to Spain next year' (future)?
options: Viajé a España el año pasado
Viajaré a España el año que viene
questions.explain: 'Viajaré' is the future tense 'I will travel'; with 'el año que viene' (next year) the future is correct.
“El ayuntamiento” means “the town hall”, the local council building.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'If we recycled more, we would help the planet'?
options: Si reciclamos más, ayudamos al planeta
Si recicláramos más, ayudaríamos al planeta
Si reciclaremos más, ayudaríamos al planeta
Si reciclábamos más, ayudaremos al planeta
questions.explain: An unreal condition uses imperfect subjunctive + conditional: 'recicláramos... ayudaríamos'.

questions.q: How do you say “I live on the third floor”?
options: Vivo en la tercera planta baja
questions.explain: “Tercer” shortens before a masculine noun, so “el tercer piso” = “the third floor”.

questions.q: Which means “In my town there is a leisure centre and a library”?
options: En mi ciudad había un polideportivo y una biblioteca
En mi ciudad hay un polideportivo y una librería
En mi ciudad hay un polideportivo y una biblioteca
En mi ciudad hay una librería y una biblioteca
questions.explain: “El polideportivo” = sports/leisure centre and “la biblioteca” = library (“librería” is a bookshop, a false friend).

questions.q: What does “los gases de efecto invernadero” mean?
questions.explain: “El efecto invernadero” = the greenhouse effect, so these are “greenhouse gases”.

questions.q: How do you say 'We must recycle more'?
questions.explain: 'Tenemos que' = 'we must/have to' and 'reciclar más' = 'recycle more'.
'El medio ambiente' is the fixed term for 'the environment' (nature).

questions.q: Which sentence means “Many species are in danger of extinction”?
options: Muchas especies están en peligro de extinción
Muchas especies son en peligro de extinción
Muchas especias están en peligro de extinción
Pocas especies están en peligro de extinción
questions.explain: “Las especies” = species (not “especias” = spices) and “en peligro de extinción” = in danger of extinction.

questions.q: What does “está a las afueras, lejos del centro” describe about a place?
options: It is right in the town centre
It is on the outskirts, far from the centre
questions.explain: “Lejos del centro” means “far from the centre”, so the place is on the outskirts.

questions.q: How do you say “We should use public transport”?
options: Debemos usar el transporte público ayer
questions.explain: “Deberíamos” = “we should” and “el transporte público” = public transport.
“La sequía” means “drought”, a long period without rain.
